answer: Here is one mechanism that works: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because tide only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, lotus is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any hollow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
